policy: Real-world knowledge is a reference and constraint layer. It must be transformed into fictional VNF content before becoming authored world truth. Do not copy article prose or import real species as VNF fauna.

anchors.realAnchor: Massive bodies accelerate unsupported objects; near Earth's surface the familiar reference acceleration is about 9.81 m/s^2.
anchors.fantasyRule: Use consistent SI mechanics and gravity as a physical constraint, while terrain/materials/organisms remain fictional.

anchors.realAnchor: Contact friction and surface conditions constrain acceleration, braking and slipping.
anchors.fantasyRule: Let rain, fictional ground materials and slope alter traction without inventing arbitrary movement buffs.

anchors.realAnchor: A breathable atmosphere is a mixture of gases; pressure and oxygen availability influence respiration.
anchors.fantasyRule: Keep physically coherent pressure and respiratory availability, but permit fictional trace gases only when explicitly authored and non-magical effects are bounded.

anchors.realAnchor: Temperature, humidity, pressure and moving air affect thermal comfort, evaporation, cloud formation and weather.
anchors.fantasyRule: Drive mist, rain, wetness and thermal load from continuous fields before naming a weather state.

anchors.realAnchor: Living bodies regulate internal conditions while activity, hydration, nutrition, temperature and injury impose competing demands.
anchors.fantasyRule: Haru's body uses human-like physiological constraints; fictional organisms use their own body/sense states rather than copied Earth anatomy.

anchors.realAnchor: Respiration depends on available oxygen, ventilation and circulation; exertion raises demand.
anchors.fantasyRule: Make breath load, oxygen delivery and exertion causally affect visible motion and recovery without exposing engine numbers to Haru.

anchors.realAnchor: Organisms occupy niches shaped by resources, climate, competition, disturbance and movement between habitats.
anchors.fantasyRule: Invent species and food/resource relations, but make habitat suitability, migration and activity respond to measurable world conditions.

anchors.realAnchor: Populations adapt across generations through heritable variation and selection pressures.
anchors.fantasyRule: Use evolutionary logic to design fictional forms and senses; do not claim individual creatures instantly evolve during gameplay.

anchors.realAnchor: Water moves through evaporation, condensation, precipitation, runoff, storage and infiltration.
anchors.fantasyRule: Use a coherent moisture cycle to drive fictional lakes, mist-fed biomes and plant water balance.
anchors.sourceFamily: Open Earth science / Wikimedia-style reference graph

anchors.realAnchor: Terrain, substrate, erosion, deposition and material strength constrain drainage, slopes and habitats.
anchors.fantasyRule: Create imaginary minerals and landforms but preserve causal consequences for footing, water and ecology.
anchors.sourceFamily: Open Earth science / Wikimedia-style reference graph

anchors.realAnchor: Rotation and orbital geometry create changing illumination cycles and seasonal energy patterns.
anchors.fantasyRule: VNF may use a fictional sky body/system, but illumination changes must be internally consistent and feed environment cycles.

anchors.realAnchor: Heat transfer occurs through conduction, convection and radiation; phase and moisture alter energy exchange.
anchors.fantasyRule: Use heat balance to drive body thermal strain and environmental transitions while fictional materials may have authored properties.

anchors.realAnchor: Learning updates expectations from experience; repeated evidence, novelty and contradiction can have different influence.
anchors.fantasyRule: Haru learns only from lived evidence/teaching and changes slowly; reference knowledge cannot directly overwrite personality or memories.
anchors.sourceFamily: Open cognitive science / Wikimedia-style reference graph

anchors.realAnchor: Material structure affects stiffness, strength, fracture, permeability and thermal behavior.
anchors.fantasyRule: Fantasy materials can be unfamiliar, but their observed properties must remain stable enough for Haru and creatures to learn causal expectations.
anchors.sourceFamily: Open materials science / Wikimedia-style reference graph

anchors.realAnchor: Reliable knowledge systems preserve source, revision and uncertainty instead of presenting every claim as equally certain.
anchors.fantasyRule: God may consult broad reference knowledge, but every VNF library anchor keeps provenance and the world only commits explicitly authored fictional facts.
